definitionZh: 溢出-anchor CSS属性提供了一个选择退出浏览器滚动锚定行为的方法,它调整了滚动位置,以尽量减少内容转移.
sourceDefinition: The overflow-anchor CSS property provides a way to opt out of the browser's scroll anchoring behavior, which adjusts scroll position to minimize content shifts.
